summary.suite: Core Sgas10 environmental suite (TIGRESS-NCR, fixed microphysics)
summary.units: Hydrogen number density n_H in cm^-3, lengths in pc, velocities in km/s, time in code units of 1 pc/(km/s) = 0.978 Myr.
summary.numbering: File number = output time / cadence, so 3D snapshot 0050 is t = 500.
summary.size_basis: Sizes are measured per model from the converted files.

summary.formats: Gridded outputs follow the Athena++ HDF5 layout: one mesh block per original tile, with an XDMF companion for the 3D snapshots. Primitive variables, the gravitational potential, and the passive scalars are in the prim dataset, the cell-centred magnetic field in B, and all other fields in user_out_var. Each projection file holds all five viewing angles as separate datasets; projected maps are line-of-sight integrals in the field units times pc (for example N_H in cm^-3 pc). Slices are one cell thick, through the cells centred 4 pc from the box centre along the sliced axis. The standard Athena++ reader (athena_read), yt, VisIt, and ParaView open them without a custom loader.
